0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Kings on the road against the Clippers, and Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Malik Monk (ankle soreness), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 138-109 defeat in their last meeting on April 5, 2026, in Sacramento.
